github.description: Connect one or more GitHub accounts directly in your browser (GitHub Device Flow) or with Personal Access Tokens (PATs). Credentials stay local on this device.
github.setupInstructions: Tap "Sign in with GitHub (Browser)" below for direct 1-tap login (no PAT needed), or paste a GitHub Personal Access Token (fine-grained or classic with repo, read:org, and workflow scopes). Use "Add account with GitHub (Browser)" or "Add account" to connect and label multiple GitHub accounts (e.g. personal, work).
